{{Quote|A delicious staple of the Gungan diet, this chowder is made from freshly shucked nyorks in a creamy broth with diced protatoes, Ojomian onions and celonslay.|The chowder's description on Dex's menu|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Nyork chowder''' was a type of [[Chowder/Legends|chowder]] made using freshly shucked [[nyork]]s, which were served in a creamy broth along with diced [[Protato/Legends|protatoes]], [[Ojomian onion]]s, and [[celonslay]]. The dish was a staple for the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="DaD" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], which was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the nyork.<ref name="Gf">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] located in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served the chowder as a lunch item. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of the diner, considered the meal delicious and charged 2.1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a cup of the chowder and 3.1 credits for a bowl. The chowder was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nyork chowder was introduced in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="DaD" /> Its name is similar to real-life [[Wikipedia:Cuisine of New York City|New York clam chowder]].<ref name="Chowder">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cookingforengineers.com/recipe/112/Clam-Chowder-New-England-Style|text=Clanm Chowder, New England Style|work=[https://www.cookingforengineers.com cookingforengineers.com]|archivedate=20250916031248}}</ref>
